uncertainties: Starfall parent has complete matching bilingual primary faces; two legacy branch APIs each returned full zero-card responses in both locales. Preserve all four failed observations; implement their original full local rows and parent-declared actual effects, not fabricated replacement IDs.
Each Arcane Brilliance tier queries current ordinary physical deck quotes at its own execution; cross-tier acquisition reactions and conditional intrinsic costs are a local uncalibrated window.

Stargazing attaches a same-turn hand-play-only grant before the original physical draw; automatic casts do not receive a double-cast program, and acquired later copies follow existing copy/lifecycle contracts.

Goo uses positive original effective damage beyond the original nonnegative remaining health; no Goo without excess or on prevented/converted damage. Original ManaThirst maximum is accepted with the damage callback selection.

Mana Bind uses actual opponent spell_cast_started and the original base spell face at the shared start window; automatic/repeated origins, interception ordering and opponent-turn semantics remain local pending CN calibration.

Random missiles recalculate current active enemy minions between transformations. Hand transform uses local cost tier plus three and retains original local cost through the existing pool transformation contract.

Printed real Choose One branches use original branch metadata and existing public targeting. Combined real choose-both execution ordering is local and deferred; no unrelated combination mechanisms are introduced.
